Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Introduced code that unnecessarily and incorrectly authenticated a public read-only MediaWiki Action API request using an OAuth Bearer token via the Authorization header, causing mwoauth-invalid-authorization errors and preventing retrieval of revisions. The code also failed to handle API continuation, so even if authentication hadn’t failed, the edit count logic would be incorrect.
